title: 7 Bryan Johnson longevity habits anyone can afford
summary: Explore seven affordable longevity habits inspired by Bryan Johnson, from better sleep and daily exercise to balanced eating and stress management.
llm_summary: Bryan Johnson’s longevity playbook boils down to seven low‑cost habits: prioritizing consistent, high‑quality sleep; moving daily with simple exercises; eating a balanced, mostly plant‑based diet; staying hydrated; managing stress through mindfulness or short breaks; keeping social connections strong; and regularly tracking health metrics to fine‑tune the routine. By integrating these tech‑friendly, affordable practices into everyday life, anyone can boost both lifespan and productivity.
